title: ECA-BLS: An Efficient Complex-Augmented Broad Learning System
abstract: arXiv:2608.29763v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Broad Learning System (BLS) is an efficient alternative to deep architectures due to its fast training, analytical learning, and strong generalization under limited data. However, existing BLS variants are confined to real-valued representations, restricting their ability to capture nonlinear interactions and second-order statistical dependencies inherent in real-world data. Notably, no prior BLS model fully exploits the complete second-order statistics that naturally emerge when data are embedded in the complex domain. To address this limitation, this paper introduces the first complex augmented Broad Learning System (CA-BLS), which transforms real-valued inputs into phase-encoded complex representations and adopts widely linear modeling to jointly leverage covariance and pseudo-covariance information via complex conjugate augmentation. translated_title: ECA-BLS：一种高效的复数增强宽度学习系统
translated_abstract: 宽度学习系统（BLS）因其训练速度快、具备解析式学习能力以及在有限数据下具有较强的泛化能力，成为深度架构的一种高效替代方案。然而，现有的BLS变体仅局限于实值表示，限制了其捕捉现实世界数据中固有的非线性交互与二阶统计依赖关系的能力。值得注意的是，此前尚无任何BLS模型能够充分利用数据嵌入复数域后自然产生的完整二阶统计信息。为解决这一局限，本文提出了首个复数增强宽度学习系统（CA-BLS），该系统将实值输入转换为相位编码的复数表示，并采用广义线性建模，通过复共轭增强的方式联合利用协方差与伪协方差信息，从而实现对潜在非线性、相干结构以及二阶依赖关系的有效建模。
tldr: 本文提出了首个复数增强宽度学习系统（CA-BLS），通过将实值输入转换为相位编码的复数表示，并借助广义线性建模联合利用协方差与伪协方差信息，有效捕捉数据中的非线性交互与二阶统计依赖。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first complex-augmented Broad Learning System (CA-BLS), which transforms real-valued inputs into phase-encoded complex representations and employs widely linear modeling to jointly leverage covariance and pseudo-covariance information, enabling effective capture of nonlinear interactions and second-order statistical dependencies.
